_comment: Paperclip DIRECT adapter config: routes an agent straight through the llm-provider OpenAI-compatible endpoint (grok + local models + claude), NO hermes. execute(ctx) POSTs to /v1/chat/completions and streams via ctx.onLog. The gateway runs trust_loopback=false (exposed via tunnel), so a key IS required — apiKeyFile points at the minted key. On a REMOTE Paperclip (VPS), set baseUrl to http://127.0.0.1:4141/v1 (the reverse-tunnel endpoint) and apiKeyFile to the key copied onto that host.
